senses.gloss: Modāgiri, a mountain(?). § 280 (Bhīmasena): II, 30, 1095 (at M.--in the east--Bhīmasena slew the king).
Modākin, a varsha in Śākadvīpa. § 575b (Śākadvīpa): VI, 11, 427 (only C., B. has Maudº).
Modāpura, a city. § 279 (Arjuna): II, 27, 1020 (in the north, subjugated by Arjuna on his digvijaya).
